name: What is the typical timeline for closing on a luxury home?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for closing on a luxury home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for closing on a luxury home typically ranges from 30 to 60 days, but can extend depending on financing complexity, inspection findings, and any unique negotiations. Cash purchases can close faster. For properties involving extensive due diligence, specialized inspections, or international buyers, the process might take longer. We work diligently to manage the closing process efficiently, coordinating with all parties involved to ensure a smooth transaction, whether in Fort Lauderdale or Boca Raton.
